dependency_decisions.native: Settings keeps full Go signed i64 nanoseconds, including negative windows/cooldowns. State stores monotonic start+signed interval and compares i128 elapsed nanoseconds instead of adding possibly out-of-platform-range durations to Instant. Go Seconds float splitting and uint32 wrapping retained; no validation clamps. Tokio clock supports paused deterministic tests.

Owner Mutex serializes config, request-time transitions and result updates as in Go. Generation Mutex keeps an old admitted state safely owned by Arc; it is never acquired before the owner in production. User execution/RPCs hold neither lock. No redundant back-pointer/cycle. Poison recovery matches deferred unlocking after mutator panic; safe encapsulation replaces exported embedded lock methods.

Admission Drop preserves panic payload and accounts overload without error. Async returns use the same completion path; a dropped admitted future is a cancelled RPC and accounts No plus error. Never-polled futures have no admission. This is a Rust lifetime adaptation, not a new timeout, retry or worker.

Use complete shared metrics owner. Four counter handles bind immediately and rebind on initialization. Callback retains only counter state; source sanitized name and independent error/overload classes retained. Metric lifecycle already validated by pd-metrics package receipt.

Reuse TraceContext typed immutable derivation; missing/wrong type/nil breaker return None, Arc identity retained. Context base is an existing Rust reference; Go nil-parent panic is prevented by the type.

Shared pd::errs::ERR_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_OPEN preserves the source PD code and diagnostic. The later whole errs receipt corrects the former uncoded enum substitution. Standard log facade still owns transition diagnostics.

source_callers.integration: Context lookup/enabled bypass, Execute and overload classification at each unary RPC. Complete grpcutil transport/interceptor owner remains open; leaf API now exists.
Explicit 30-second region-meta instance and settings changes migrate to shared package. Seven native logical call sites use the shared owner. Physical-RPC context placement remains grpcutil work.
